turns.content: For |psi>=sqrt(1/15)|phi_1>+sqrt(2/15)|phi_2>+(2/sqrt(15))|phi_3>+(4/sqrt(15))|phi_4> in an orthonormal basis, calculate each coefficient magnitude squared and <psi|psi>.
Given H|phi_n>=nE_0|phi_n> for n=1,2,3,4, list the energy paired with each basis state.
Use those weights and eigenvalues to calculate the unnormalized numerator <psi|H|psi>, using the norm found above for the subsequent expectation value.
Divide by the state norm to obtain the average energy measured over repeated trials.
Check the result by normalizing the coefficient probabilities and taking their energy-weighted sum.
Report the average energy in units of E_0.
